This episode is brought to you by https://themagnetbaron.com/ your go to source for anything magnetic! Whether it's Warhammer, Age of Sigmar, Star Wars Legion or any other game, Magnet Baron probably has the magnets you need! They even have prepackaged kits for your favourite models! If you need magnets for your next project check out the link below! 

Long time friend of the channel Brent is back in the studio and this time he's embracing chaos and bringing all sorts of Tzeentchian shenanigans today to take on our resident Overlord Michael himself! Will the twisted sorceries of the Thousand Sons prevail or will the Necrons ancient technology prove too strong?
